candidates.title: BRS MLC Ramana accuses Revanth Reddy of ignoring weavers’ issues in Sircilla
candidates.excerpt: BRS MLC L Ramana criticised Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy over his Sircilla meeting, alleging that it lacked measures for weavers. He cited 54 weaver deaths since January 2024 and questioned the utilisation of Rs 1,753 crore allocated for weavers.
